dedupe_keys.name: lithium ion battery indentation tests and thermal runaway severity

description: This dataset contains mechanically induced internal-short-circuit tests on more than one hundred lithium-ion cells. Oak Ridge and Sandia collaborators use single-side indentation to assess thermal-runaway behaviour across cell chemistries, capacities and states of charge. Time-series measurements include cell voltage, compressive load, indenter stroke and temperature, linked to dimensions, mass and other cell properties. A documented calculation assigns severity scores from zero to one hundred. Mendeley version 2 lists 254 Excel files free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a controlled laboratory test collection, not a calendar series of service failures, and the public metadata do not give a uniform time step. Test severity cannot be treated as an operational incident probability or a complete battery-pack fire model. A reviewer-assessed use is checking cell-level failure-response assumptions in storage-risk simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related system-level storage resource. No workbook or severity calculation was executed.
